sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Simulates cyber incidents to test response capabilities and coordination. Includes tabletop scenarios, live drills, and post-mortem reviews. Engages stakeholders across IT, legal, communications, and leadership. Identifies gaps in procedures, tools, and decision-making. Helps refine playbooks and escalation protocols.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves readiness and confidence in handling real incidents. Reduces response time and impact during crises. Enhances cross-functional collaboration and clarity. Supports regulatory and customer expectations. Builds resilience and continuous improvement.
